title: Science says ancient roman concrete could repair its own cracks: The secret was hidden in tiny white chunks
description: Modern concrete can become vulnerable when cracks allow water and chemicals to seep into its interior. Ancient Roman concrete, by contrast, appears to have contained a reserve of reactive, calcium-rich material that could contribute to its long-term durability.

title: Qom: A province of ancient beacons along historic routes
description: TEHRAN - Scattered across the mountains, plains and historic routes of Qom province, a group of ancient Meels, standalone beacon towers once used to guide travelers and caravans, offers a distinctive glimpse into the history of travel and communication in central Iran.

title: The Vulnerability of Emotional Neediness: Ancient Wisdom from Chanakya Niti on Relationship Pitfalls
description: When individuals experience intense inner emotional lack, any breadcrumb of kindness or attention can feel like genuine affection. Ancient philosopher Chanakya addressed this psychological vulnerability in Chanakya Niti, warning against letting personal neediness cloud rational judgment.
